contentList.content: Your Strength increases to 23, increases to 27 at 10th level, and increases to 31 at 20th level.
Gain <LSTag Tooltip="Resistance">resistance</LSTag> to all damage types.
Emanate a murderous aura that intimidates enemies within 3 meters. This ability can be toggled on and off.
Your ranged weapon attacks deal additional <LSTag Tooltip="Strength">Strength</LSTag><LSTag Tooltip="AbilityModifier">modifier</LSTag> physical damage.
Deal an additional 1d6 <LSTag Tooltip="Force">force</LSTag> damage on critical hits.
When you score a <LSTag Tooltip="CriticalHit">critical hit</LSTag>, you deal an additional 7 damage. Can be learned multiple times.
The number required to score a <LSTag Tooltip="CriticalHit">critical hit</LSTag> is reduced by 1. Can be learned multiple times.
Gain an additional <LSTag Tooltip="BonusAction">bonus action</LSTag>. Can be learned multiple times.
